label: My return: an updated return (ITR-U) - allowed?, interest, additional tax

params.name: updated_by
params.label: the last day for it (chip close.dates updated_by: 48 months from the end of the AY)

params.name: months
params.label: months from the end of the AY to the day of filing (a part month counts)

params.name: months_a
params.label: 234A(1A): months from the day after the due date

params.name: months_b
params.label: 234B(1A): months from 1 April of the AY

params.name: extra_tax
params.label: the further tax: tax on the updated income less the tax on the income of the return before, less TDS on the income added

params.name: tds
params.label: that year's TDS / TCS in all

params.name: bars
params.label: the bars that apply (chip myreturn.itru_rules bars)

params.name: known
params.label: that year's tax can be worked out here (chip myreturn.tax_of_year known, and not over its surcharge line)

description_nl: 2026-10-07: s.139(8A): within 48 months of the end of the AY, unless a bar applies; s.140B: the further tax with interest u/s 234A(1A) (from the day after the due date) and 234B(1A) (from 1 April of the AY, when advance tax fell short) on it, then the additional tax - 25% / 50% / 60% / 70% of that tax and interest within 12 / 24 / 36 / 48 months (chip close.itr_u). The return's own tax was paid with it; the further tax is the base.
